<Subject 3> (appears in [Shot 2], [Shot 3]): fully_preserved - the red floral hair ornaments, long black hair, pearl-like earrings, crimson embroidered robes, dark sash, wide sleeves, and trailing red ribbons are retained; only her initial facing direction and speaking gesture change.
<Subject 4> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2], [Shot 3]): fully_preserved - the dark-barked plum tree, snow-covered red blossoms, misty blue-white forest, snowy ground, and falling snow are retained as the continuous environment; only framing and depth emphasis change.

detailed_description:
Cinematic high-detail Chinese fantasy drama, with a cool blue-white winter palette contrasted by saturated red blossoms and crimson robes. Use soft diffused snowfall light, shallow atmospheric depth, graceful controlled camera movement, realistic fabric motion, and seamless continuity between the four reference images.
[Shot 1] A wide establishing shot shows the snow-covered forest path receding into pale mist, with the large red-plum tree anchoring the left side of the frame. <Subject 1> and <Subject 2> enter from the lower right and walk carefully through ankle-deep snow toward the distant flowering tree; her translucent blue sleeves and ribbons trail in the wind, while his black robes hang heavily and his long hair moves slightly. Snowflakes cross the lens in the foreground. The camera makes a slow forward dolly of moderate distance, keeping both figures in a balanced two-shot. Footsteps compress the snow, fabric rustles, and cold wind moves through bare branches. <Subject 4> supplies the full snowy plum-forest setting, while the visible costumes and silhouettes follow <Picture 1> and <Picture 2>.
[Shot 2] At 00:01.700, cut to a medium-wide view beneath the plum tree. <Subject 3> stands several meters ahead near the center-left, partially framed by red blossoms, facing away from the approaching pair; her crimson sleeves and long trailing ribbons overlap the snowy ground. <Subject 1> and <Subject 2> stop in the right midground, visibly relieved. The camera slowly tracks left and pushes in, revealing the spatial relationship among all three characters. <Subject 1> (S1) steps forward, raises one hand slightly, and says with emotional relief, <d>[Chinese] 师姐，我终于找到你了。</d> Snowfall remains steady, with branches creaking softly and boots shifting in the snow. The character identities and costume details remain locked to <Picture 1>, <Picture 2>, and <Picture 3>.
[Shot 3] At 00:03.250, a medium shot begins as <Subject 3> turns toward them, her face becoming clearly visible between red blossoms. She offers a gentle but practical expression and gathers one wide sleeve near her waist. <Subject 3> (S2) turns toward the pair and says, <d>[Chinese] 你们来了，群主刚睡下，我正准备给群主做饭去。</d> The camera performs a small clockwise arc around her, then widens to include the other two. <Subject 1> and <Subject 2> step beside her and lean forward together. 
<Subject 2> (S3) shout together, <d>[Chinese] 师姐我也来帮忙！</d> Their voices echo lightly through the forest as snow lands on their sleeves; the red blossoms, blue robe, black robe, and white landscape form the final balanced tableau.

overall_soundscape:
Continuous soft snowfall, a light wintry breeze passing through plum branches, occasional branch creaks, muted footsteps compressing powdery snow, gentle robe and sleeve rustling, and subtle snow displacement beneath the characters. Dialogue is clear and naturally reverberates in the open forest.
